form.label: Technical Coverage
form.description: Shared technical evidence for active frameworks. Saved and cached results return quickly; use Measurement Center to run a live check. These signals support an assessment and never replace scope, ownership, or assessor judgment.

search.query: | inputlookup framework_catalog.csv | lookup ccp_framework_selections framework_key OUTPUT selected | eval selected=if(coalesce(selected,default_selected)=1,1,0) | search selected=1 | stats values(framework_name) as names count as framework_rows | eval active_frameworks=if(framework_rows=0,"No active frameworks",mvjoin(names,", ")) | table active_frameworks

div.p: Use current telemetry to see whether monitoring signals are available in the last 24 hours. A Pass means the signal exists, not that the underlying control is fully effective.
div.div: Recommended path: start here to find missing telemetry, open the related check, then save the result as evidence before making an assessment decision.

single.option: framework selection is managed in Framework Setup

search.query: | makeresults | eval summary="No cached result", events=0, measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z" | append [| inputlookup ccp_measurement_cache | search adapter_key="splunk.recent_index_activity" | sort 0 - measured_at | head 1 | eval summary=coalesce(observed_value,"No cached result"), events=tonumber(replace(observed_value,"^[^0-9]*([0-9]+).*$","\\1"))] | sort 0 - measured_at | head 1 | table summary events

single.option: saved or cached technical result; run a live check in Measurement Center

search.query: | makeresults | eval Source="Splunk host metadata", measured=0, Assets=0, measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z" | append [| makeresults | eval Source="Exposure Analytics", measured=0, Assets=0, measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"] | append [| inputlookup ccp_measurement_cache | search adapter_key="splunk.host_metadata" | sort 0 - measured_at | head 1 | rex field=observed_value "^(?<Assets>[0-9]+)" | eval Source="Splunk host metadata", measured=if(status="Pass",1,0)] | append [| inputlookup ccp_measurement_cache | search adapter_key="splunk.exposure_analytics" | sort 0 - measured_at | head 1 | rex field=observed_value "hosts=(?<host_assets>[0-9]+), ip=(?<ip_assets>[0-9]+), mac=(?<mac_assets>[0-9]+), users=(?<user_assets>[0-9]+)" | eval Source="Exposure Analytics", measured=if(status="Pass",1,0), Assets=coalesce(host_assets,0)." hosts, ".coalesce(ip_assets,0)." ip, ".coalesce(mac_assets,0)." mac, ".coalesce(user_assets,0)." users"] | stats max(measured) as "Data available (1=yes)" max(Assets) as Assets by Source | table Source "Data available (1=yes)" Assets

table.option: saved or cached technical result; run a live check in Measurement Center

search.query: | makeresults | eval adapter_key="splunk.authentication_activity", Signal="Authentication", Status="Not assessed", Events="No cached result", measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z" | append [| makeresults | eval adapter_key="splunk.privileged_activity", Signal="Privileged activity", Status="Not assessed", Events="No cached result", measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"] | append [| inputlookup ccp_measurement_cache | where adapter_key="splunk.authentication_activity" OR adapter_key="splunk.privileged_activity" | eval Signal=case(adapter_key="splunk.authentication_activity","Authentication",adapter_key="splunk.privileged_activity","Privileged activity"), Status=if(status="Pass","Signal available","Not assessed"), Events=coalesce(observed_value,"No cached result")] | sort 0 - measured_at | dedup adapter_key | table Signal Status Events

table.option: saved or cached technical result; run a live check in Measurement Center

search.query: | makeresults | eval adapter_key="splunk.detection_activity", Signal="Detection", Status="Not assessed", Events="No cached result", measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z" | append [| makeresults | eval adapter_key="splunk.vulnerability_activity", Signal="Vulnerability", Status="Not assessed", Events="No cached result", measured_at="1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"] | append [| inputlookup ccp_measurement_cache | where adapter_key="splunk.detection_activity" OR adapter_key="splunk.vulnerability_activity" | eval Signal=case(adapter_key="splunk.detection_activity","Detection",adapter_key="splunk.vulnerability_activity","Vulnerability"), Status=if(status="Pass","Signal available","Not assessed"), Events=coalesce(observed_value,"No cached result")] | sort 0 - measured_at | dedup adapter_key | table Signal Status Events

table.option: saved or cached technical result; run a live check in Measurement Center

search.query: | rest /services/data/indexes splunk_server=local | search disabled=0 NOT title="_*" | eval retention_days=round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs/86400,1) | stats count as Indexes count(eval(retention_days>=180)) as Meeting_180_Day_Target min(retention_days) as Minimum_Configured_Days | eval Status=case(Indexes=0,"Not assessed",Meeting_180_Day_Target=Indexes,"Pass",1=1,"Partial") | table Status Indexes Meeting_180_Day_Target Minimum_Configured_Days

html.div: How to use this: Open the relevant check, confirm the system scope and time window, investigate missing signals, then save the result with evidence and limitations. Technical availability is supporting evidence; it is not an automatic audit conclusion.
